# `/ui-plugin-slots` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /ui-plugin-slots/v1

`listUiPluginSlotsV1` — List UI plugin slots — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns the static slot registry (extension points the platform exposes). `name` / `description` are localized via AtlasJS TranslateService. Filtering uses API Standard Collection Parameters. `state` supports `eq` with values `active`, `deprecated`, or `removed`. Example: `filters=state eq "active"`. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present).

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui-slots:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: state: eq — e.g. `state eq "active"`
  - `allLangs` (query) — default False — When `true`, `name` and `description` are returned as full locale maps instead of a single translated string.
- Returns 200: array of uipluginslot
